name: Zizur Mayor / Zizur Nagusia (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided blue over white within a border counterchanged, charged at the centre with the arms of Zizur Mayor (three red roses on white, timbred with a helmet and plumes).
history: The flag of Zizur Mayor is divided horizontally through the middle, the upper part blue (Pantone 2925) and the lower white, with a border also divided horizontally and counterchanged; the arms are those officially in use, formed of three roses gules arranged in a triangle on a field argent, with a knight's helmet with a crest of blue and red plumes and a bordure of blue and silver.

features.role: border counterchanged, white on the blue and blue on the white
